name: Trial of the Sea Lion
summary: Tajarri asks you to seek two pendant halves in Moonglade and bring the joined Pendant of the Sea Lion to Dendrite Starblaze. Clues from the residents point toward the halves, and the Shrine of Remulos is where they can be joined.

sections.title: Tajarri's Request
sections.body: Tajarri at the Shrine of Remulos asks you to find two halves of a pendant in Moonglade. The residents may know where the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance can be found. Bring the joined Pendant of the Sea Lion to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven.

sections.title: At the Shrine
sections.body: The two pendant halves can be joined near the Shrine of Remulos. Once formed, the Pendant of the Sea Lion is to be brought to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven.

faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze waits in Nighthaven for the joined Pendant of the Sea Lion. Tajarri sends you to find the two pendant halves in Moonglade and join them near the Shrine of Remulos.

faq.q: Where can I find clues about the pendant halves?
faq.answer: The residents of Moonglade may have clues about where the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance are located.

faq.q: Where do I join the two halves?
faq.answer: The two pendant halves can be joined in proximity to the Shrine of Remulos.
Dendrite Starblaze is in the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade.

attribution: In-game quest text: Trial of the Sea Lion
